setName: salute | Vail Après Ski | RAW CUTS
description: Good vibes set for working. Mid-to-low energy, good for starting the day or locking in on a project anytime.

setName: MPH - Live in Tokyo, Japan | UKF On Air
RÜFÜS DU SOL • Fred again.. • Lost Frequencies | Mountain Deep House Mix
Fred again.. - Green Room Set (Maka’s Birthday, Rome)
Chris Stussy @ Hudson River Boat Party, New York for Teksupport
description: Could def work for morning

setName: Cloonee B2B Prospa - Live at Destino, Ibiza
description: Overall good, summer vibes. Not too much energy, not too little

setName: FIFI (DJ Set) - Elevator Music
description: Perfect set length, she has major aura, and samples victory lap. Check, check, and check

setName: Fred again.. HydeFM twitch stream in San Francisco
¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U: 100% The Prodigy Mix
description: Solid standard techno work energy-wise, with his signature style. Awesome for locking in on any task

setName: Tim Reaper w/ Fracture & Blackeye
description: I liked all of the callouts in this one at the start, definitely makes it feel like radio which is a certain vibe but if you’re in the mood it can work, and provides a continuous solid beat, but it was too much. Wish the music could speak more for itself

setName: Zack Fox | Boiler Room: New York
description: Nice balance, some lower energy and higher and VERY high energy moments

setName: Barry Can’t Swim DJ Set (Brooklyn, NYC - 20th June 2026)
description: Groovy as all hell.

setName: Zack Fox (DJ Set) - Elevator Music
Fred again.. & Thomas Bangalter (USB002, Alexandra Palace, London 27 February 2026)
description: Absolute all time intro
bestMoments: 1:06 INSANE double drops, 1:10 Leavemealone, 1:20 music sounds better with you, 1:45 Just Stand There

setName: berlin deep house mix
description: Great for chill vibes, but can be higher energy if you need it to be. Super balanced all around set!

setName: Nick Cheo (DJ Set) - Elevator Music
description: Some good popular tunes mixed in here - like a super up-leveled version of a bedroom DJ set
bestMoments: Piano in first ~10:00, beat switch at ~41:00

setName: Ben Böhmer, RÜFÜS DU SOL, Adriatique | Sunset Mix in the French Alps | by V.A.L for RESONANCE
description: Really beautiful scenery and smooth mixes - nothing groundbreaking here but one of the best morning mixes I’ve heard in a while

setName: Notion UKG And Bassline Set Live From DJ Mag HQ
description: To be honest could have rated higher because the music was 7-8 level - mixing didn’t really impress me that much though

setName: KETTAMA @ Coachella 2026 - Yuma Stage
description: Some solid mixing in here! I’m biased because I love the hard kicks and trancey vibes. Think this stuff can play anytime because it isn’t too hardcore for the morning, but can by hype if you need hype

setName: Sam Gellaitry (DJ Set) - Elevator Music
description: Good, not remarkable in my opinion. Great for working, but not sure I am listening to this independently

setName: Fred again.. - Rooftop Live (Arun’s Roof, London)
description: All time elite vibes set. Definitely needs the video to attain the full 9/10 rating, but it is really an amazing piece of work

setName: KETTAMA | Boiler Room: London
description: Best Kettama set, not necessarily in terms of mixing prowess but just general vibes

setName: Folamour (DJ Set) - Elevator Music
description: So fucking groovy! Folamour also brings like ultimate friendly energy and good vibes

setName: berlin deep house mix
description: Lots of great tracks in here, and I love that Chris Luno is always very upfront with the track list so I can save distinct new songs!

setName: Folamour | Boiler Room x Sugar Mountain 2024
description: Some characters in this one, video is such good vibes - french house 101

setName: touching grass and playing house
description: Video is SO needed - this is one the most idyllic sets I have ever witnessed, it looks like a grassy field from a fairy tale. Luno is so effortlessly cool and the track selection is a great mix of deep house as always

setName: Conducta | Mixmag Lab London
description: Pretty high energy, almost MPH-like UK garage mixing
bestMoments: Right at the start, great drop into the high energy part of the set; good grooving around ~29:00; ~44:00 is hype asf

setName: playing vibey tunes on the highway
description: Good vibes being in the car, clean mixes, good for work; nothing extraordinary here

setName: Sammy Virji | Boiler Room: Denver
description: High energy from literally the first minute - really awesome UKG set. Would be closer to an 8 ranking but there are lulls here and there
bestMoments: 29:30 sick build and drop; 43:00 awesome Damager drop

setName: RÜFÜS DU SOL (DJ SET) - Mayan Warrior - Burning Man 2024
description: Might be the ultimate Rufus set between the music and visuals from Burning Man
bestMoments: ~1 hr 25 mins - Awesome build and drop for Innerbloom

setName: ARC On The River: KETTAMA
description: Pretty standard Kettama fare here, no crazy mixing - so if you like him you’ll like this!

setName: Riordan | Boiler Room: London
description: This one really picked up steam towards the end in the last ~15 mins with some of his bigger tracks - decent but probably not one I will be revisiting often

setName: MPH | Live In Hollywood
pool party house mix
description: I will probably rate most Chris Luno destination-type sets either a 6 or a 7 - always good vibes and fairly chill with smooth mixing. If a Luno set gets an 8, I think it means he either really controls the energy very well or is doing very technical transitions

setName: Tuesday night at the snooker club… (Barry Can’t Swim, September 2026)
description: Mad chill! Fits so well with the setting. Almost like chill trance. Hour went by in what felt like 5 minutes

setName: HAMDI @ KNOCKDOWN CENTER | HAMDI FC vs NEW YORK
description: Hamdi has such a nice mix of house and hard bass/dubstep, and this set is no exception (bonus points for folding in the Damager VIP x Sammy Virji and some crafty Victory Lap flips). TONS of good remixes here
bestMoments: ~40:00 approx 4 mins of sick victory lap edits

setName: DJ BORING b2b salute | Boiler Room x AVA Festival 2024
description: One of the better lock in/get work done sets I’ve ever listened to! Also, the way Salute like sways and headbangs is very satisfying, I can’t explain why but I love it. Lots of fun drops here

setName: MPH | Kindred Radio
description: Very long build-up, which helps this one be more broadly applicable (MPH is normally all high energy, meaning not really good for morning/late night).
